title: Introduction
slide_intent: Mark the beginning of the strategy section so a reader can distinguish a chapter boundary from a page of guidance.
strategic_value: The green section treatment can make the sequence of chapters easy to recognize throughout the manual.
demonstration: A single white Introduction heading sits at upper left on a dark green ground beneath the section number and opposite the folio.
practical_value: Use this divider when opening a major section of the book.

content_islands.name: Section identifiers
content_islands.spec: Place the small section number and label at upper left and the folio at upper right.

content_islands.name: Chapter title
content_islands.spec: Set the title large in white beneath the identifiers, leaving the remainder of the dark green field clear.
